audit.note: a pure suggestion demo - the port raises no event

deviations.what: sap.m.Input.enableTableAutoPopinMode is @since 1.89 - newer than the 1.71 floor but kept for the 1:1 port, since the second of the three Inputs exists to show exactly that. The app needs a UI5 release >= 1.89 for that one to behave differently from the first.

the three Inputs are the sample: the same 123 suggestion rows and the same four columns, laid out three ways - default, enableTableAutoPopinMode, and a custom popin configuration (popinDisplay='Inline' with minScreenWidth='Large' and demandPopin on the last two columns). Every column property is carried 1:1, including the widths the second and third set.

the Price cell is a composite currency binding in the sample (parts Price + CurrencyCode through sap.ui.model.type.Currency with showMeasure TRUE, so the unit is part of the text). The port binds the two fields as one composite text ('{PRICE} {CURRENCYCODE}'), which is what that formatter renders, since the mock's prices are plain numbers.
the sample has no handler at all - its controller only loads the mock - so the port raises no event either. Typing filters the suggestions in the BROWSER, over the rows the backend already sent.
